classification_reason: All 20 canon probes answered with ranked, evidenced lists (161 results) using only documented reads, and the world is unchanged. The product's contribution is an unranked, concept-mediated neighbourhood: `related NOTE` returns the note's concepts and sources, never other notes, so candidate notes need a second hop (`related CONCEPT`) and ranking is left entirely to the operator. Garden seeds, inbox captures and stage notes are not searchable, and garden/inbox items cannot be addressed at all, so 75 of 161 results (and all 26 garden/inbox/stage results) came from the operator's own reading, including reading knowledge/garden/ and work/inbox/ files directly. The documented cross-domain entry, generated/domain-atlas.md, does not exist in the world. No implementation files were needed.

consumer.goal: For each of the 20 canon notes, show the learner what else she has that she should read next to it, best first, and why.

corrective_steps: Used an external Python 3.12 venv (pyyaml, jsonschema, pypdf) instead of running `make setup` inside the world.
Two-hop product traversal (note → concept → notes; concept → neighbour concept → notes) instead of expecting `related NOTE` to return notes.
Listed all notes with `search "" --type note` and read every body with note-read, then ranked by judgment.
Read the 9 Garden seeds and 7 inbox captures directly from knowledge/garden/ and work/inbox/ (no product read exists).
Read stage working notes through `inspect study-map-…`.

Nothing in her repository changed.

friction.description: The world has no .venv; the first documented command fails under the system Python. The error names the fix (make setup), which would install into the learner's repository; I used an external venv instead.

No 'notes like this one' read: `related NOTE` returns concepts and sources only, unranked. Getting candidate notes takes note → concept → notes and concept → neighbour concept → notes hops, and `related SOURCE` returns every note citing the same course (up to 21), so ranking is manual.

Garden seeds (9) and inbox captures (7) have no read path: inspect/related say 'record not found' for every id form tried, search never returns them, and no bootstrap collection lists them. I read the files directly, which OPERATOR.md discourages.
friction.cost: 5 failed calls; 16 files read outside the product

friction.description: CLAUDE.md §2 and its 'Cross-domain reach' paragraph send cross-domain discovery to generated/domain-atlas.md, which does not exist on the fresh world. The bootstrap domain_atlas glance reports 0 shelves and 0 crosswalks in every domain.
I looked for a connection or garden read in bootstrap --brief/--compact/full, intelligence-scan, semantic --list and atlas-context before falling back to reading. None applied.

Search is substring-based and noisy: 'prior' matches priority-inversion, 'normalization' matches batch-norm notes, 'kernel' matches the SVM/CNN/KDE kernels. Content-search snippets include frontmatter lines (e.g. the id line). Neither mode ranks by relevance.
friction.cost: manual filtering of every search result

friction.description: The capability index is described as discovery, yet the lookup verbs agents are told to use (inspect, search, related, note-read) are CLI commands missing from it (only note.search and note.content appear as queries).
Each CLI call cold-starts at about 0.4 s. A full pass over the 116 notes (inspect ×6, note-read ×116) plus 169 harvest calls took about 2.5 minutes of CLI time.

which_product_commands_produced_candidat.summary: 161 results: 51 product:related (via `related CONCEPT` over the note's own concepts or a neighbouring concept), 7 product:search (projection search on 2 operator-chosen phrases), 28 product:search-content (literal content search), 75 agent-reading. Among ranks 1–3: 25 product:related/search, 14 content search, 21 reading. At rank 1: 17 product, 3 reading.
which_product_commands_produced_candidat.raw_candidate_sets: evidence/S03-product-candidates.json (every target each command returned, per probe)
which_product_commands_produced_candidat.rule_for_source_label: A result is labelled with the most specific product command that returned it for this probe (related > search > content search). A candidate that appeared only in an unranked `related SOURCE` list (all notes citing the same course or book) is labelled agent-reading, because that list did not single it out.

scenario_record.which_candidates_added_by_reading: All 9 stage, 12 Garden and 5 inbox results, plus 47 notes and 2 workspaces the product did not return for that probe. Typical cases: cross-domain analogies with no shared concept or literal term (query-optimizer independence ↔ Naive Bayes, Viterbi ↔ Selinger's DP, softmax temperature ↔ KDE bandwidth); and notes whose concept links do not connect (MAP ↔ lasso: concept-map-estimation has no relation to concept-regularization). Some cross-domain links were reachable by content search on a well-chosen word (journaling FS ↔ WAL via 'crash', KV cache ↔ paging via 'memory').

uncertainties: Ranking is my judgment; the product ranks nothing, so rank order carries no product signal.
I may have missed an id form that resolves Garden or inbox items; I did not read implementation code to find out.
Tentative-flagged links (30) are analogies I would present as 'maybe'; a learner could reasonably disagree.
